summary: Parses a UI layer definition string and constructs the matching layer object. Copies the name argument into a stack buffer seeded from byte_5EA438, normalizes it, and classifies it against aNormal / aModal to pick a constructor (ConstructorWithVTableAndSubInit_9140 with mode 0 or 1); an unrecognized type formats an 'undefined layer type' error into byte_7CDCF0 and reports it via sub_493C80. The constructed layer is stored at this+424 and linked with DoublyLinkedListNodeInsert. Then iterates child definitions with sub_491FB0, dispatching each token: aName_2 layers gate ResourcePathBuilder on the this+410 flag and the this+412 count being below 4, sound focus / sound lost focus tokens are copied into the layer at byte offsets 108 and 148 and loaded via TextureSurfaceLoader, and gizmo / page tokens are handed to sub_492A40 (then SetInitCall with this+424) and sub_492710. Exits by releasing the this+404 reference count and clearing this+424.

operations.description: Build the working buffer: copy byte_5EA438[0] into SrcStr[0], zero the remaining 124 bytes, and clear the trailing terminator words.
When a name argument is supplied, copy it into SrcStr and normalize it via sub_589901.
Increment the reentrancy / parse-depth counter at this+404.

Compare SrcStr against aNormal via sub_588410; when it is not the normal layer name, allocate 188 bytes with OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper and construct a normal layer with ConstructorWithVTableAndSubInit_9140(0).
Else when SrcStr matches aModal construct a modal layer; otherwise format 'undefined layer type %s' into byte_7CDCF0 with StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck and report it via sub_493C80(3, buffer).
Modal layer path: allocate 188 bytes with OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper and construct with ConstructorWithVTableAndSubInit_9140(1); on allocation failure set the layer pointer to 0.
Store the constructed (or zero) layer object at this+424.
Set up the default screen region via ShortComputation_a9c0(0, 599, 0, 799).
Insert the new layer object into the UI layer list with DoublyLinkedListNodeInsert.
While sub_491FB0(this) yields the next child definition token, stop early when sub_587C20(unk_7CDB70, asc_5CC4F4) signals the end marker.
When the token matches aName_2 via sub_5654A0 and the byte at this+410 is set and the counter at this+412 is below 4, rebuild the path via ResourcePathBuilder; then resolve the token with sub_49AD50.

Otherwise classify the token: aSoundFocus copies the token into the layer object at byte offset 108; aSoundLostfocus copies it into byte offset 148; both fall through to TextureSurfaceLoader. A aGizmo token is created via sub_492A40 and, when non-null, bound to the layer with SetInitCall(result, this+424); a aPage token is dispatched to sub_492710. Gizmo and page tokens continue without texture loading.
On exit decrement the parse-depth counter at this+404 and clear the layer pointer at this+424 to 0.
